description: Sets Development's plans and products from gemmein/payments.json's contents ({ plans, products, consent }). The file wins: a row edited in the dashboard is overwritten, and the answer lists every change first. Needs Stripe connected, which is the founder's step (connect_payments returns the link); a product's downloadable file is uploaded on the dashboard's product card (a file path can't travel through a chat) — deliveryUrl works here. This is what a founder may call setting prices, plans or what they sell.
name: set_payments
title: Set plans and products
